raw_segments.text: Whatever may be the efforts of the Americans of the South to maintain slavery, they will
Slavery, which is now confined to a single tract of the civilized earth, which is attacked
by Christianity as unjust, and by political economy as prejudicial, and which is now contrasted
with democratic liberties and the information of our age, cannot survive.
By the choice of the master, or by the will of the slave, it will cease, and in either
case great calamities may be expected to ensue.
If liberty be refused to the Negroes of the South, they will in the end seize it for themselves
If it be given, they will abuse it ere long.
